Retrieves the list of internet-facing assets detected for your organization by EASM
GET
https://api.zsapi.net/easm/easm-ui/v1/organizations/:orgId/assets

Retrieves the list of internet-facing assets detected for your organization by EASM. To learn more, see About Asset Inventory and Understanding Asset Discovery.

Request
​
PATH PARAMETERS
orgId
string
REQUIRED

Identifier extracted from the path. Renamed automatically; review the description and tighten the schema if needed.

HEADER PARAMETERS
Authorization
string
REQUIRED

API authentication token

Default value: Bearer your-token
Responses
​
200
400
401
500

OK

APPLICATION/JSON
Schema
Example (auto)
SCHEMA
next_link
string

The URL with a page offset to access the subsequent set of assets

prev_link
string

The URL with a page offset to access the previous set of assets

results
object[]
total_results
integer
